text: なんだい　きみも　イワヤマ　トンネル　いくのか

structure.jp: きみも　イワヤマ　トンネル　いくのか
structure.en: you're going to Rock Tunnel too?

patterns.name: 〜のか
patterns.explanation: のか at the end is a question about something the speaker has just realised: 'oh, so that's how it is?'. いくのか = 'so you're going?'.

patterns.name: 〜だい
patterns.explanation: だい after a question word is a friendly, manly way to ask. なんだい = 'what's this?'.
